newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Xijiang field back up after shut down.
newsitem.headline: China's Xijiang field back up after shut down.

text.p: China's offshore 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) Xijiang field is back up after more than a week after it was closed by a mechanical problem during severe weather, traders said on Thursday.
The field shut down early last week in severe weather surrounding Typhoon Sally.
The 110,000 bpd Nanhai field and the 65,000 bpd Liu Hua field, which shut down owing to the weather last week, came back up on Saturday.
Xijiang resumed operations on Wednesday afternoon, traders said.
They said it was not unusual for the fields to face shut down during the latter part of the year because of volatile weather.

China is loading more than one million barrels of Minas crude oil late September and early October, which traders said was partly geared to covering for the loss of production at the three offshore fields.
